title: SuperInventorySee
description: This project adds a LIVE invsee, where you can edit peoples items.
body:
SuperInventorySee is a lightweight, high-performance tool designed for server administrators who need to monitor player inventories in real-time. Whether you're tracking down stolen items on an SMP or checking for "illegal" gear, SuperInvSee provides a seamless, vanilla-friendly way to peek inside.

# Features
- Live Inspection: View any online player's inventory exactly as they see it.

- Real-Time Sync: As the player moves items, your view updates instantly.

- 1.21x Support: Fully optimized for the latest Minecraft versions and Java 21.

- Admin Focused: Lightweight code that won't lag your server, even during high-traffic events.

# Permissions:
/invsee  — Opens the specified player's inventory.

Permission: invsee.admin (Default: For OPs)

# Installation
Download the .jar file.

Drop it into your server's plugins folder (for Paper/Spigot).

Restart your server.

You're ready to go! No complex configuration required.
